sources: Esri World_Imagery around the site points

values.note: No water or dump station in the park; the dump stations at Yampa River State Park, 12 miles west, may be used from May 1. Restrooms, dumpster, fire pits, picnic tables, shade shelters and parking pads.

Fire pits, Picnic tables, Shade shelters, Parking pads'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/elkhead-reservoir-state-park/elkhead-reservoir-state-park-camping-lodging ('Elkhead Reservoir is open for camping from May 1 to November 30 each year'; 'Elkhead Reservoir State Park is not open for winter camping'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com (Elkhead Reservoir State Park listing, Pronghorn Campground) or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. 14 days in any 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site, vehicles kept on the pads; check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

values.note: 30 electric sites (021-050; 036, 038, 049 and 050 ADA), 19 of them pull-throughs; cpwshop gives no maximum vehicle lengths for this loop.

sites.source: cpwshop.com campsiteDetails for Pronghorn sites 021-050 (Driveway Entry; Maximum Vehicle Length blank) + campgroundDetails loop listing (Pronghorn Campground: 26 Electric + 4 Electric - ADA), read 2026-10-28

note: Newer campground on a treeless peninsula at Elkhead Reservoir, east of Craig, ~6,400 ft; hardened gravel pads and shade shelters. The outer-loop sites sit on the open bare-shore apron (drawdown exposes a wide tan band; the high-water edge is at the sites). Shares the Yampa River State Park office. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: confirmed 30 sites, 20/30/50-amp electric on every site, no water/sewer, no water or dump in the park; season ~May-Sep -> May 1 - Nov 30 (CPW); added pull-throughs (19), url/window 180/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees (2026-10-12 cpwshop, $36 electric) left as is. Note: dropped the restated site count/hookups/season/booking, 'Camp Colorado' and the RV Life rating line (the rating group carries it).
flags: Waterfront (stored lakefront): cpwshop tags the 15 outer-loop sites 021-035 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' and the 15 inner sites 036-050 untagged - consistent with lakefront for the outer loop. On Esri imagery (pool appears full) the outer site points sit ~15-50 m from the waterline on open ground. No contrary claim.
Pin 40.5664,-107.3824 is 128 m from the 30-site centroid (40.56595,-107.38380); the loop spans ~300 m, within tolerance.
No maximum vehicle length published for Pronghorn on cpwshop (field blank on all 30 sites); max_rig_ft left unset.
